scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path 'public')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'public' }; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force dashboard/* public/; Copy-Item dashboard/*.html public/ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item dashboard/*.js public/ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
